pattern_ref: Konflux mutable-pipelineRef rollup (PROGRESS.md; Tekton git-resolver revision: main)
description: Rewrites `value: main` (or master) revision params of Tekton git resolvers under .tekton/ to the referenced repository's current HEAD SHA, resolved per-URL at apply time via git ls-remote.

tests.name: pins a git-resolver revision under .tekton/
tests.before:
apiVersion: tekton.dev/v1
kind: PipelineRun
spec:
  pipelineRef:
    resolver: git
    params:
      - name: url
        value: "https://github.com/example/konflux-build-catalog"
      - name: revision
        value: main
      - name: pathInRepo
        value: pipelines/docker-build.yaml

tests.name: leaves non-revision mains alone
tests.before:
spec:
  params:
    - name: target-branch
      value: main
